# `StringArbitrary`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Arbitrary\StringArbitrary`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Arbitrary/StringArbitrary.php#L22) — **Version:** working tree

**Implements:** [`ArbitraryInterface`](/api/classes/ArbitraryInterface)

Generates random strings and shrinks them by length toward the empty string,
then character-by-character toward 'a'.

Two alphabets are available: an ASCII printable subset (32..126) and the
full Unicode space via `Arbitrary\mb_chr`(). Length is chosen uniformly within an
inclusive range.

## Constructor

```php
__construct(
    int $minLength = 0,
    int $maxLength = 100,
    bool $unicode = false,
)
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$minLength` | `int` | `0` |  |
| `$maxLength` | `int` | `100` |  |
| `$unicode` | `bool` | `false` | When true, characters are drawn from the full Unicode codepoint space (U+0001..U+10FFFF, excluding surrogates); otherwise ASCII printable. |
